record_type_quote: In the present report, we investigate whether their analytical results in Table 2 are computationally reproducible and further test their replicability and robustness to: (1) independently coding the main independent variable from the raw data on populist episodes, (2) adding more years to the sample, and (3) examining the sensitivity to small changes in research choices about which populist spells to include in the sample.

targets.authors: Funke, M., Schularick, M. and Trebesch, C.
targets.title: Populist leaders and the economy
targets.evidence_quote: In the present report, we investigate whether their analytical results in Table 2 are computationally reproducible and further test their replicability and robustness to: (1) independently coding the main independent variable from the raw data on populist episodes, (2) adding more years to the sample, and (3) examining the sensitivity to small changes in research choices about which populist spells to include in the sample.
targets.outcome_computational_quote: We also successfully reproduced FST’s main tables (Table 2) using their codes, with a trivial difference in two of six replicated coefficient estimates (point estimate of -0.96 vs -0.97, as well as -0.72 vs -0.73).
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: Additionally, our replications also suggest that results are largely consistent with the main text of the paper and are not sensitive to the small changes and subjective choices made.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors reproduce the original coefficients with explicitly trivial differences. They interpret their alternatives as largely consistent and robust overall, despite smaller and noisier estimates with the extended time period; their stated interpretation governs the robustness axis.

reasoning: Re-analysis of the original replication package, with alternative variable coding and sample periods, rather than a new independent sample.
